children: , the developer of the Midnight electric air taxi, said the U.S. antitrust waiting period has expired on its planned acquisition of
Boeing's (BA) Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu subsidiaries, satisfying a key condition for the deal to close. Archer shares were down 1.23% in premarket.

The deal still needs other customary closing conditions to be met, including further regulatory approvals that Archer says are underway, and the company continues to expect completion by the end of 2026.

The acquisition would combine the three Boeing units' work in autonomy, eVTOL aircraft, unmanned aircraft systems and airspace intelligence with Archer's own aircraft and its AI foundation model, ZEE. Archer pitches the combined business as an end-to-end physical AI platform for aerospace and defense.

title: Archer Clears U.S. Antitrust Hurdle on Boeing Units Deal
